## Data visualization - Tools
<span style="color:#7f8c8d;">ggplot2</span>

- **Layers** (build plots step by step)  
- **Geoms** (visual representation: points, lines, bars)  
- **Aesthetics** (mapping data to visual properties)  
- **Facets** (split data into subplots)  

## Data visualization - Tools
<span style="color:#7f8c8d;">gtExtras</span>

- Extension to the gt package for enhanced tables  
- Adds visual elements (bars, icons, color scales)  
- Makes tables more informative and easier to read  




## From Raw Data to Insight: Building a Clear Visualization

- We want to visualize the relationship between health expenditure and life expectancy  

- A correct plot is not enough → it must be clear and interpretable  

- So how do we move from raw data to meaningful insight?  

## Clear principles to avoid this

![](images/nasty_plot.svg)

---

## Step 1 — Raw encoding

![](images/plot_1.svg)


- Position on axes is the most effective encoding
- Scatterplot is appropriate for two continuous variables

At this stage:

- The chart is technically correct  
- But it does not yet communicate a clear message  

---

## Step 2 — Add clarity and context

![](images/plot_2.svg)



- Axes must be clearly labeled
- A plot should be understandable without external explanation

Improvement:

- We add axis labels and a title  
- The reader now understands what is shown  

---

## Step 3 — Reveal structure

![](images/plot_3.svg)



- Help the audience see patterns, not just data points

Improvement:

- Adding a trend line reveals the relationship  
- We begin to see diminishing returns  

---

## Step 4 — Reduce visual noise

![](images/plot_4.svg)

- Avoid unnecessary visual elements: Maximize data-to-ink ratio  


Improvement:

- Focus shifts to the data (through cleaner theme and subtle colors)

---

## Step 5 — Create focus

![](images/plot_5.svg)



- Not all data points are equally important: Use visual hierarchy to guide attention 

Improvement:

- Key countries (US, Switzerland) are highlighted  
- The narrative begins to emerge  

---

## Step 6 — Tell the story

![](images/plot_6.svg)



- A good graph tells a complete story  
- It should be interpretable without explanation  

Improvement:

- Selective labeling of relevant countries  
- Strong, message-driven title
